name: transcription-skill
title_zh: 本地 Whisper 把音视频落成带时间轴的双语字幕
tagline_zh: 不用上传云端，mp4/mov/mkv/wav/m4a/mp3 直接转成带时间戳的逐字稿，日英优先。
tagline_en: No cloud uploads—mp4/mov/mkv/wav/m4a/mp3 become timestamped transcripts, Japanese & English first, plus SRT/VTT.
desc_en: Transcribe speech in audio or video files (mp4, mov, mkv, wav, m4a, mp3) into a structured, timestamped Transcript with a local ASR engine (faster-whisper), Japanese and English first-class; export plain SRT/VTT; derive speech intervals. Use this skill whenever the user asks what is said in a recording, wants a transcript, timestamps of speech, word timings, or timed text to hand to a subtitle or
why_zh: faster-whisper 本地跑，隐私不出去；时间戳细到词级，能直接抽语音区间，不是整段糊弄。
why_en: Runs faster-whisper locally—privacy stays put; word-level timestamps let you extract speech intervals, not just blobs.
limit_zh: 只认本地已装的 faster-whisper 和 ffmpeg；模型首次要下载。日英之外的语言效果随缘，长视频吃内存。
limit_en: Needs local faster-whisper & ffmpeg; model downloads on first run. Non-JA/EN quality varies; >1hr files may strain memory.
title_en: Local Whisper turns audio/video into timestamped bilingual.
